content:
Ah, the step was cancelled before applying because of the server restart!
Let's apply the multi-replace change to `ISOFormEditorView.jsx` now. We will use `multi_replace_file_content` to apply:
1. State declarations & `useEffect` update to keep generic parsed values empty and set them as dynamic placeholders.
2. Render inputs with dynamic placeholders.

args.Description: Modify ISOFormEditorView to treat generic parsed values (Mẫu quy trình, Tên quy trình) as placeholders instead of pre-filled input values.
args.Instruction: Add symbolPlaceholder and namePlaceholder states, check for generic parsed values inside useEffect, and map placeholders dynamically in JSX.

ReplacementChunks.ReplacementContent:
handleInputChange('symbol', e.target.value)} placeholder={symbolPlaceholder} style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #D1D5DB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', color: '#1F2937' }} />
handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)} placeholder={namePlaceholder} style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #D1D5DB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', transition: 'border-color 0.2s', color: '#1F2937' }} />
ReplacementChunks.TargetContent:
handleInputChange('symbol', e.target.value)} placeholder="VD: G7.CL-QT01" style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #D1D5DB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', color: '#1F2937' }} />
handleInputChange('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="Nhập tên quy trình..." style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #D1D5DB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', transition: 'border-color 0.2s', color: '#1F2937' }} />

args.toolAction: Replacing prefilled values with placeholders in ISOFormEditorView
